protected_grant_rationale: Both patterns match DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS in scripts/ods-scope.ts (db/migrations/** at line 86, db/prepared/** at line 87 — both unchanged by this addendum) and are therefore unconditionally protected absent a resolved grant. This addendum and docs/ops/wave2/W2_B4_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json are the authority for the registry entry; the entry in scripts/ods-scope.ts is its machine-enforced counterpart, and the three must agree exactly — which tests/ods/ods-scope.test.ts asserts by reading protected_grant from the node authority, following the pattern already established for HPO-ODS-W2-08, W2-09 and W2-11. NO db/migrations and NO db/prepared file is changed by THIS mission: the grant is registered in advance precisely so the successor implementation mission cannot claim retroactive authorization from the fact that a path changed.

protected_grant.glob_justification: A glob rather than exact literals, deliberately and narrowly. The concrete migration ordinal, drizzle snapshot name and prepared-journal wrapper ordinal are determined by a mechanical re-measurement at the P1A sync point, so exact literals could not be written here without either being wrong or freezing a slot this node explicitly refuses to freeze (docs/ops/wave2/W2_B4_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json p1a_synchronization.migration_slot_candidate.FROZEN = false). The two patterns are exactly the surfaces Wave 2 migrations and their journal wrappers occupy, and no third. This is mechanically identical in shape to HPO-ODS-W2-01, the original Wave 2 grant, which held the same two patterns on the historical Wave 2 branch. W2-01 is FROZEN_UNCHANGED and is NOT reused, because a grant is bound to exactly one branch and codex/w2-methodology-objects-r1 is not this node's branch.
protected_grant.narrowness_note: Deliberately NOT db/prepared/** — that would reach every hosted and local bootstrap file the P1A and hosted lanes own, including the three paths HPO-ODS-W2-11 holds and the two stella_hosted_* files HPO-ODS-W2-03 and W2-05 hold.
